Generate documentation for a survey dataset with a language model

Source: R/llm.R
sd_document.Rd

The "Vaihe 2" of the documentation pipeline: takes the statistics R already computed (sd_summarise()) and asks a language model to turn them into readable prose. Currently supports a local Ollama model via the ellmer package.

Usage

sd_document(
  x,
  model = "gemma3:12b",
  backend = "ollama",
  system_prompt = NULL,
  instructions = NULL,
  timeout_s = 1200,
  save_to = NULL,
  language = "fi",
  store = NULL,
  top_k = 2
)

Arguments

x

An sd_data object (statistics are computed automatically — see sd_summarise() for the recommended order of sd_set_missing() and sd_detect_roles() first) or an already-computed sd_summary object.

model

Name of the Ollama model to use, e.g. "gemma3:12b".

backend

Which chat backend to use. Currently only "ollama" is supported.

system_prompt

System prompt for the model. NULL (the default) uses a built-in system prompt, in the language given by language, instructing the model to write professional documentation and use only the given figures.

instructions

Passed on to sd_build_prompt().

timeout_s

Request timeout in seconds (local models can be slow on a first response). Default 1200 (20 minutes).

save_to

Optional file path. If given, the generated text is also written there with writeLines().

language

Language the generated documentation should be written in – one of "fi" (Finnish, the default), "en" (English) or "sv" (Swedish). Only affects the built-in system_prompt and instructions; has no effect when both are supplied explicitly. See sd_build_prompt().

store

Optional connected ragnar RagnarStore (see ragnar::ragnar_store_connect()) built from your own reference material. When given, sd_retrieve_context() looks up background material for each variable and inserts it into the prompt. NULL (the default) skips retrieval entirely – behaves exactly as before this parameter was added.

top_k

Number of chunks retrieved per variable when store is given. Passed on to sd_retrieve_context().

Value

An object of class sd_documentation with elements text (the generated documentation), prompt (the full prompt sent), model, backend, chat (the underlying ellmer chat object — use chat$chat("...") to ask follow-up questions in the same conversation), and created.

Requirements

sd_document() needs a running Ollama installation with the chosen model already pulled — see https://ollama.com, then ollama pull <model> on the command line. Run sd_check_ollama() first to verify this quickly, without waiting for a full generation. A response can take anywhere from a few seconds to several minutes — larger models without GPU acceleration are slow, and the very first call after starting Ollama also pays a one-off cost to load the model into memory. sd_document() prints a message before sending the request so a long wait doesn't look like it has silently frozen.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
aineisto <- sd_read("survey_data.csv")
aineisto <- sd_set_missing(aineisto, codes = c(99, -9), vars = c("tt1", "tt2"))
aineisto <- sd_detect_roles(aineisto)
dokumentaatio <- sd_document(aineisto, model = "gemma3:12b")
print(dokumentaatio)

# Jatkokeskustelu samassa kontekstissa:
dokumentaatio$chat$chat("Mikä ulottuvuus sai parhaat keskiarvot?")
} # }
